metric_definitions.director: unit signed physical extrusion vector after SI conversion
metric_definitions.thickness: absolute signed extrusion thickness in SI
metric_definitions.axial_span_fraction: (max_i(x_i dot director)-min_i(x_i dot director))/thickness for every tetrahedron
metric_definitions.condition: sigma_max(J W^-1)/sigma_min(J W^-1), J edge columns, W regular-tet edge columns from (0,0,0),(1,0,0),(1/2,sqrt(3)/2,0),(1/2,sqrt(3)/6,sqrt(2/3)); all singular values finite and positive
metric_definitions.interpretation: geometric sampling/conditioning only, not uniform layers or universal FE accuracy; interval consequence applies only to covered segments with axial extent>thickness/2
